dates_and_calendars.date_schedule

Gets a list of dates based on the provided values, which can then be used as input for other functions.

Available as lseg.data.dates_and_calendars.date_schedule.

date_schedule(
    frequency: DateScheduleFrequency | str = None,
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    end_date: OptDateTime = None,
    calendar_day_of_month: int | None = None,
    calendars: list[str] | None = None,
    currencies: list[str] | None = None,
    day_of_week: DayOfWeek | str | None = None,
    count: int | None = None,
) -> list[datetime64]

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
frequency DateScheduleFrequency | str No None The frequency of dates in the predefined period.
start_date OptDateTime No None The start date of the predetermined list of dates. The start date must be earlier or equal to the end date. Mandatory if endDate is in the past.
end_date OptDateTime No None The end date of the predetermined list of dates. If start_date is not set end_date is used to define a list of dates from today to the end date; end_date and count should not be set at a time; end_date must be later or equal to start_date. Mandatory if count is not specified.
calendar_day_of_month int | None No None The number of the days of the month to which the dates are adjusted. The first date in the list is defined as the corresponding day of the month to which the start date belongs. Mandatory if frequency is set to 'Monthly'.
calendars list[str] | None No None Calendars to determine the working days and national holidays for particular countries. Optional if currencies is provided.
currencies list[str] | None No None Currencies to use for calculation of the date for the working day or weekend. Optional if calendars is provided.
day_of_week DayOfWeek | str | None No None The day of week to which dates are adjusted. The first date in the list is defined as corresponding day of week following the start date. The last date in the list is defined as corresponding day of week preceding the end date.
count int | None No None The number of dates from the start date to retrieve. Mandatory if end_date is not specified.

Returns

List[np.datetime64]

List of np.datetime64 dates.

Example

import datetime
import lseg.data as ld
from lseg.data import dates_and_calendars

ld.open_session("platform.default")

dates = ld.dates_and_calendars.date_schedule(
   start_date=datetime.date(2019, 4, 30),
   count=10,
   frequency=dates_and_calendars.DateScheduleFrequency.WEEKLY,
   calendars=["EMU", "GER"],
   day_of_week="Tuesday",
)

Related types

DateScheduleFrequency

The frequency of dates in the predefined period. The possible values are: The possible values are:

  • Daily,
  • Weekly,
  • BiWeekly,
  • Monthly,
Name Value Description
DateScheduleFrequency.BI_WEEKLY 'BiWeekly'
DateScheduleFrequency.DAILY 'Daily'
DateScheduleFrequency.MONTHLY 'Monthly'
DateScheduleFrequency.WEEKLY 'Weekly'

DayOfWeek

The day of week to which dates are adjusted. The first date in the list is defined as corresponding day of week following the start date. The last date in the list is defined as corresponding day of week preceding the end date. The possible values are:

  • Sunday,
  • Monday,
  • Tuesday,
  • Wednesday,
  • Thursday,
  • Friday,
  • Saturday
Name Value Description

DayOfWeek.MONDAY 'Monday'
DayOfWeek.SATURDAY 'Saturday'
DayOfWeek.SUNDAY 'Sunday'
DayOfWeek.THURSDAY 'Thursday'
DayOfWeek.TUESDAY 'Tuesday'
DayOfWeek.WEDNESDAY 'Wednesday'
